$comment: Hand-written (B-13); no pydantic model yet. One request from the Python runner to the PowerShell lever host (B-15 reads it on stdin). The runner has already checked identity, role, client scope, approval and params before it sends this; the host re-checks the shape and the entry, never the permissions. B-15 should update this file if it changes a field.
title: LeverRequest
description: One lever call sent across the Python to PowerShell bridge.

version.description: Shape version of this request (STD-CF-4); a host rejects a version it does not know.

request_id.description: Correlation id, also written to the audit v2 record (STD-AU-2) and the trace.

params.description: Already validated against the lever's ParamSpec by the runner (core/levers/schema.py).

function.description: An exported <ApprovedVerb>-<Noun> function of that module (STD-PS-3).

as_of.description: Pinned date or UTC time for anything time-based (STD-PS-10).

implementation.description: mock, or a real adapter name from the client binding.

adapter.description: The one client binding this call may use (TEN-04), copied from config/clients/<id>.json by the runner.

CredentialRef.description: A Key Vault secret NAME (D6-10: client-<id>-<purpose>), never a value (STD-CF-7).
